snippet.title: Wrongly Accused Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/38...

Wrongly Accused is set in a future where all past and current crime has already been solved by an A.I. known as Lucidia. Due to the government's Human Intelligence Laws, however, each crime must also be solved by human input.

You are a new recruit at the Agency of Historical Accuracy where you are tasked with investigating historical miscarriages of justice in order to exonerate the wrongly accused and bring the real perpetrators to light. 

#detectivegames #indiegame #narrativegame #mysterygame
